Marked no-dsa by Debian Security Team; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-95508

Debian security tracker marks libslirp unfixed, but upstream libslirp 4.8.0 already includes commit 14ec36e107a8c9af7d0a80c3571fe39b291ff1d4 (TFTP relative-path restrictions for Windows hosts). CVE-2020-7211 is a Windows-host directory traversal in slirp TFTP using backslash path separators; this DHI package builds on Linux where G_OS_WIN32 is undefined, so the Windows-specific traversal checks are not compiled into the shipped binaries.
